VERSION 3.29.x.x

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/orientation/sensor/qml/LockOrientationToggle.qml
    IMPORT org.xovi.Manager 1.0
    TRAVERSE QuickSettingsToggle
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool xoviShortcutEnabled: { ManagerNavigation.launcherRevision; return ManagerNavigation.nativeEntryEnabled("rotation", "quick") }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
